summary: Machine Learning Engineer & Software Developer with 7 years of experience in software development and 5 years of experience working on AI projects across NLP, geospatial analytics, classical ML, and computer vision. I enjoy taking ideas from scratch to fully deployed products—whether working independently or as part of a small, fast-moving R&D team.

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer
positions.description:
Development of ML models and data pipelines in remote sensing for deforestation detection in the context of EU Deforestation Regulation
• Developed and shipped a new land-cover segmentation model in Python/PyTorch that outperformed the prior production baseline by 9 pp IoU
• Drive ongoing improvements to model architecture and data pipelines, resulting in a further ~3 pp IoU gain in recent iterations
• Engineered an end-to-end training framework with custom data loaders, augmentation pipeline, and annotation/model versioning—cutting epoch time by an order of magnitude and improving experiment reproducibility
• Built a modular benchmark suite that tracks core performance metrics across various deforestation-analysis workflows
• Refactored the codebase to improve modularity, flexibility, and robustness - accelerating development and reduce failure rates
• Working on development of cocoa commodity maps across multiple countries in West Africa and South America
• Contributing to broader R&D efforts by reviewing literature, evaluating third-party data sources, testing new methods, etc.

company.name: osapiens
company.description:
osapiens – one platform for sustainable growth 

osapiens develops software that empowers companies to drive sustainable growth across their entire value chain.  

The osapiens HUB, a multi-tenant hyperscaler platform designed to enable cross-company collaboration and AI-automation, combines over 25 solutions in two categories: Transparency solutions enable companies to report on financial and non-financial data, manage supply chains, mitigate risk of all kinds (including cyber-risks and trade- and geo-political risks), and ensure compliance with product, reporting and supply chain regulations. Efficiency solutions enable AI-driven supplier collaboration, maintenance, service, and distribution processes to improve operational performance and strengthen competitiveness.  

osapiens was founded in 2018. Headquartered in Mannheim, Germany, with offices across Europe and the United States, the company works with an international team of over 550 employees. It supports more than 2,500 customers worldwide, from SMEs to global enterprises across industries.
